# PlayedFlow { #timetoalign.timelines.PlayedFlow }

```python
timelines.PlayedFlow(timeline, unit, number_type, chunks, findings=())
```

The flow a timeline's flow control plays, and what playing it found.

What :meth:`Timeline.get_flow <timetoalign.timelines.Timeline.get_flow>`
returns: the runs of the flow placed one after the other, through which
positions convert as through any :class:`ResolvedFlowMap`, together
with the findings of the engine.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name     | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| findings | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[FlowFinding](`timetoalign.timelines.flow.engine.FlowFinding`), ...\] | What playing the flow control found, in the order found: a flow that never ends, a flow ending at a Break, two destinations holding together, a stretch never played (with the cause ``single_playback`` where the ``single`` flow leaves out what the ``default`` flow plays). The ``printed`` flow has none. |
